subject: Data infrastructure behind [COMPANY]'s expansion
text:
Hi [NAME],  

 I saw the tomosynthesis CE mark last month and the expansion into 10 European markets this year. 

 A significant acceleration with new modalities, new markets, new certification cycles, all on a team of ~50! 

 I've spent most of this year working with the Hoppr and Hologic engineering team on annotation and model validation infrastructure.  

 The specific friction points are usually the same: clinical annotators disengaging from tools that don't match their reading environment, QA overhead compounding per workload, and audit trail assembly becoming a manual burden at each certification cycle. 

 Curious whether any of that is live at [COMPANY] right now? Happy to connect later this week to show you how we've both firms solve them.

subject: US clinic launch and annotation infrastructure risk
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the Series C! With US clinics live, annotation infrastructure
fragmentation becomes your first bottleneck - different regions, different
tools, compliance risk at FDA submission time.

Having built FDA-ready infrastructure with AbbVie and Conavi Medical, we
know that this is the right time to standardise the workflow.

We spoke with Mattias previously in January, offering a design partnership
so we can build the customisation your sensors need; you get infrastructure
that scales across all three regions with regulatory compliance built in.

Worth 30 mins with your technical team early next week? We're in Stockholm
the week after next if that suits you better.

subject: An Evening on Surgical AI, SRS - Thursday 23rd July
text:
Hi [NAME], pleasure to meet you. 

 We are hosting an exclusive networking dinner during SRS for surgical AI leaders to share their experience and challenges building AI in surgery and medtech. 

 The evening will take place at 
The Salon at the Premier Steakhouse, Diplomat Prime on Thursday 23rd July. We expect great conversation with attendees ranging from surgical robotics startups to established medtech leaders. 

 Encord runs this type of event across major conferences and tech hubs. The agenda stays entirely attendee-led, with no slides or presentations, to keep us up to speed on what is state-of-the-art in surgical AI.

 I will send over a formal invite if you are.

subject: Ankur Kapoor recommended we chat | Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

Ankur suggested I reach out. For context, his team evaluated Encord
successfully last year, and having reconnected recently, he recommended
meeting with you, Sasha and Puneet as the next step.

He flagged three challenges Healthineers is facing:

   1. Stricter FDA/PCCP requirements on annotation and data residency
   2. Growing use of video training data, requiring multimodal annotation
   3. A fast-growing number of post-PoC models across types and disease
   areas

Encord addresses all three through unified curation and annotation, plus
external expert medical services.

We'd like to scope your team's needs and build a picture of how we can save
engineering time and improve model performance across all the Healthineers
teams.

We're on the East Coast late next week and the week after. When would work
to meet in-person?
